description: This file contains unit tests for the CustomFieldService class within the OrangeHRM project, specifically testing the service related to custom fields in the PIM module.

classes.name: CustomFieldServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the CustomFieldService class functionalities, such as DAO retrieval, getter/setter generation, and custom field management.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of CustomFieldService before each test.

methods.name: testGetCustomFieldDao
methods.description: Asserts that the method getCustomFieldDao returns an instance of CustomFieldDao.

methods.name: testGenerateGettersByFieldNumbers
methods.description: Tests the generation of getter method names based on field numbers.

methods.name: testGenerateFieldKeyByFieldId
methods.description: Checks if generateFieldKeyByFieldId produces the correct key for a given field ID.

methods.name: testGenerateSetterByFieldKey
methods.description: Verifies the correct setter method name is generated from a field key.

methods.name: testExtractFieldNumbersFromFieldKeys
methods.description: Tests extraction of field numbers from a list of field key strings.

methods.name: testGetAllFieldsInUse
methods.description: Mocks the DAO to test the method that retrieves all in-use custom field IDs.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenNotDeleteOption
methods.description: Tests behavior when deleting extra data without the delete option set, ensuring no update call is made.

methods.name: testDeleteRelatedEmployeeCustomFieldsExtraDataWhenDeleteOption
methods.description: Tests behavior when deleting extra data with the delete option set, ensuring update method is called.
